name: invinite-financial-data
description: Fetch and analyze financial data using the Invinite Data API — US inflation, GDP, labor, Treasury yields, company fundamentals, financial statements, SEC filings, earnings calls (transcripts, guidance, Q&A, live calls), company news, institutional ownership, insider trades, beneficial ownership (13D / 13G), planned insider sales (Form 144), SEC bulk data files, and more.
